results.content:
The president’s popularity differs across the country.

According to Civiqs' online polling, as of late August, Trump has the highest net approval rating in Wyoming, where 56 percent of voters approve of his performance and 35 percent disapprove.

The president’s weakest numbers can be found in Democratic strongholds. His approval rating is weakest in Hawaii, where 18 percent approve of his job performance, and 81 percent disapprove. [...] The most recent polling data from The Economist and YouGov, taken August 21-28 found that 36 percent of Hispanic voters approved of how Trump is handling his job.

Party: Democrats were most unfavorable toward Trump, with 98% disapproving, followed by independents at 62% disapproval. Meanwhile, Republicans were the most favorable toward Trump, with 82% approving of Trump's job performance.

Race: Black or African-American voters had the highest unfavorable opinion of Trump, with 88% disapproving, followed by Hispanic/Latino at 72% disapproval, Other at 68% disapproval and white at 59% disapproval.

Black Idahoans approve at 33 percent and disapprove at 67 percent. Hispanic and Latino residents approve at 45 percent and disapprove at 51 percent. Those identifying as another race approve at 44 percent and disapprove at 50 percent.
